Soft polished storybook fantasy game painting matching the approved reference: rich cobalt/lapis blue, pale sky-blue underside, warm yellow-gold curved ornaments, tactile blue ceramic and brushed soft gold, soft colored contours, dimensional smooth gradients, readable friendly proportions. The reference is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY, never copy its shark anatomy into this subject. Keep species identity and distinct body proportions. No trident, three-pronged symbols, letters or heraldic logos; only simple flowing yellow wave/spiral decorations. No heavy black outlines, plastic toy render or detached sparkle. Face SCREEN RIGHT, head/front on right and body/rear left; no front-facing or left-facing animal. Whole subject inside central 78% of canvas, generous alpha padding on all sides. True transparent alpha PNG, clean antialiasing, no white/black matte fringe, background, checkerboard, scenery, external shadow, dust, grid, text or watermark.

sprite.prompt: Edit this exact 4-column by 2-row eight-pose blue-gold guardian sprite sheet ONLY to correct safe framing. Keep every distinct pose, anatomy, armor, cape motion, staff, shield and right-facing helmet EXACTLY as supplied. Within EACH of the eight equal square cells, uniformly REDUCE each complete character to 75% its current size, using one consistent scale and same rigid head/torso placement. Reconstruct no new anatomy because complete characters already fit. Preserve ALL feet, cape and staff tips. Need at least 15% actual fully transparent padding on every side of EVERY cell. Do NOT crop away blank canvas margins. Keep 4x2 layout and 2:1 image aspect, true alpha transparency. No borders, labels, background, grid or trident. Do not change the eight different physical motion poses into clones.

registration.method: Visually selected opaque rigid anchor; RGB translation measured on source; one common scale and center for entire loop baked into final PNG
